name: Caml
note: INRIA ML dialect; its first complete implementation was released in 1987
typeSystem: Static, strong, Hindley-Milner type inference inherited from ML, with algebraic data types and pattern matching; Caml Light and later Caml Special Light refined this into what would directly become OCaml's core type system.
runtime: Early Caml compiled to bytecode run by a portable virtual machine; Caml Special Light (1995) added a native-code compiler, and the project was renamed OCaml the following year.

runtimes.name: Caml Light bytecode VM
runtimes.role: Portable bytecode interpreter for the Caml Light dialect (1990).

runtimes.name: Native (Caml Special Light)
runtimes.role: Native-code compiler introduced in Caml Special Light (1995), the direct precursor to OCaml's ocamlopt.

compilers.name: camllight
compilers.role: Bytecode compiler for the Caml Light dialect.

compilers.name: Caml Special Light (CSL)
compilers.role: Added native code generation; renamed OCaml in 1996.

concurrencyModel: N/A; single-threaded evaluation, as in early ML implementations

codeExample.caption: Recursive factorial, in the syntax later carried into OCaml
